caveats: Same-process capture-window association, not causal CPU/wall-time attribution.
2-second GIL-scheduled Python sampling; native C/CUDA internals unavailable.
Queries without in-interval samples remain unsampled, not zero-cost.
Concurrent waiting calls do not duplicate a process/sample in counts.
Inclusive caller occurrences overlap and must not be summed as time.
No latency, SLO, numerical-correctness or G1/G2 improvement claim.
